rubric.description: Uses a loop that traverses every element of arr
Correctly accumulates the running sum of the elements
Uses a loop that examines every element of arr
Correctly compares each element to target (e.g. arr[i] == target)
Initializes tracking variables for the largest and second-largest values using the first two elements, in the correct relative order
Uses a loop to examine the remaining elements (e.g. starting from index 2)
Correctly updates both the largest and second-largest trackers when a new overall largest is found (shifting the old largest into second)
Correctly updates the second-largest tracker when an element falls between it and the largest, and returns the correct final value
